_meta.yield_discipline_note: Per [[tey-vs-gross-yield-conflation]]: indicative_gross_ytm_pct is now a REAL traded GROSS YTM pulled from the EMMA RTRS tape (per-CUSIP, sale-to-customer preferred) as of 2026-05-30 — NOT MMD-modeled, NOT TEY, NOT net-of-fees. See per-slot indicative_yield_source + yield_confidence (HIGH <=75d / MEDIUM <=1yr / STALE >1yr / NO_TAPE) and the sidecar data/emma_trade_activity.json. THREE liquidity caveats: (1) slot 14 San Jose TAB 798147AQ9 has NEVER traded — yield left null, not invented; (2) slot 3 Clovis 189342B49 last traded 2015 (STALE, ~11yr) and slot 10 Bethany 13048VG69 only at 2023 issuance (7 trades) — both indicative-only; (3) thin tickets (some <$25k par) carry wide retail markups, so a single print is not a fair mid. TEY GROSS-UP is BRACKET-DEPENDENT: multiply the gross YTM by ~2.01 at CA's top combined marginal rate (37% fed + 13.3% CA = 50.3%, income >~$1M) or ~1.80 at a typical high earner (44.3%); e.g. the wrapped CCRC sleeve at ~4.1% gross (Aldersly traded) -> ~8.3% / ~7.4% TEY. AMT caveat: full federal exemption holds for the 501(c)(3) CCRC conduits (Aldersly, Bethany) but NOT cleanly for CalHFA housing bond 13032WDK7 (specified private-activity bond, AMT-exposed). Net-of-fees subtracts the wrapper expense ratio. Do not conflate, and do not compare TEY to nominal taxable yields without the duration caveat (several names are 2046-2057 bullets).
